# Results (generated by tools/results.py from outputs/metrics.json; do not edit by hand)

Reference path: net replacement S3 (half-life 10 yr); 2026-2050; median demographics unless marked MC (joint uncertainty within the reference scenario). Carbon factors: A1-A3 of case-study items decarbonised 2026-2050 (Horup et al. 2025; item-level mapping, data/material_item_map.csv); A4-A5 e^(-0.01 (t - 2025)) (Resch et al. 2021); C1-C4, held items and soil at 2025. Accounting: time-resolved (upfront in the construction year, replacements and repaints in the year they occur within 2026-2050; later events and end of life are committed emissions, below).
